title: Accept Any String View
goal: Make a function accept both string slices and owned strings cleanly using AsRef.
hints: Look for a trait that provides reference-to-reference conversions.
The parameter should implement `AsRef<str>`, and trait methods convert references.
explanation: `impl AsRef<str>` accepts any type that can be borrowed as a string slice, including `&str`, `String`, and `&String`. Calling `.as_ref()` on the parameter produces a `&str` view. Choosing `String` causes type mismatches `E0308` when callers pass string slices or references. Calling `.as_str()` fails with `E0599` because generic type parameters do not inherit concrete struct methods.
